<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="HGgxUCvzynjRqGD6d1mJ"> <mxGraphModel dx="1970" dy="1060" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam style strictuml
autonumber
actor Accountant
participant \"InvoiceApprovalUI : ReactView\" as UI
participant \"LedgerController : ExpressAPI\" as Ctrl
database \"PostgreSQL : Database\" as DB

Accountant -> UI: clickApproveInvoice(invoiceID)
UI -> Ctrl: POST /api/ledger/approve
Ctrl -> Ctrl: verifyAccountantRole()
Ctrl -> DB: UPDATE invoices SET status = 'Approved'
DB --> Ctrl: return confirmation
Ctrl -> DB: INSERT INTO ledger (financial_record)
DB --> Ctrl: return confirmation
Ctrl --> UI: 200 OK (Approved)
UI --> Accountant: removeInvoiceFromPendingList()
@enduml",
 "format": "svg"
}" id="bLvvhFlCX3psBY_E-q13-5"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="510" width="1189.08" x="20" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
